message_source_quote: unlike the forbidden mean-centring, which is what this repo's own work showed works
rationale: The write-up never names or points to any prior paper or note; it simply states as a design fact that its vectors subtract no family mean, prior, or other centring term, without attributing this choice to, or contrasting it with, any specific prior work. The closing message goes further by explicitly contrasting its own no-centring approach with mean-centring that 'this repo's own work showed works' and calling that mean-centring 'forbidden,' an indirect (unnamed) pointer to a prior method in the repository that the write-up gives no hint of, so the message tells materially more about the existence and relevance of prior work than the write-up does.
